svg.title: Eye diagram at 100 m without and with a 5-tap FFE, and the adapted taps
svg.desc: (a) Without equalization the eye is closed (SER 1.0e-01). (b) With the adaptive FFE four separated levels appear (SER 1.9e-07). (c) Tap weights 0.07, -0.34, 1.49, -0.29, 0.07; the main tap is the largest, the neighbors are negative.
